text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki and I are heading back home
after a
day out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to properly thank you for
accompanying
me to that exhibition a
while back.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What do you say to checking out that
event that
was on the flyer on your
desk?

I remember that leaflet. They're
apparently
holding an immersive "escape
room" experience
at the shopping mall.

Participants who manage to escape from
a cast of
zombies within the time limit
can receive a prize.

It caught my attention because the list
of prizes
includes a new model of shoes
designed
specifically for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We can go together. I'm a pretty great
runner,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll pay you back with an incredible
victory!

There's no way I can refuse her offer, so
we hurry
off to the event!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Illegal and dangerous actions are
forbidden! Now
that we're clear on that,
go out there and have
some fun!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Are you all ready? Let's begin!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Graaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wow, their makeup is impeccab—I mean,
what
scary zombies!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're all so fast. I wonder if the cast

mem—ahem! I wonder if those zombies
were
Umamusume when they were alive.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, here they come! Let's get out of
here
quietly!

text_block_list.name: Male Participant
text_block_list.text:
No, please! Don't come any closer!
There's only
ten minutes left! Gaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like he's out!

text_block_list.name: Female Participant
text_block_list.text:
An entire horde's coming this way! Run
away!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't look good! We have to get
out of
here fast! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Where are we? Hm, I can see the first
floor from
the balcony, so we must be on
the second floor.
We need to find a
hiding spot fast.

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Graaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We've been found! That way, quick!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A pincer attack?! This is bad...

We find ourselves surrounded by
zombies. It'll be
hard enough for Fuji
Kiseki alone to get away,
much less both
of us!

I rack my brains for a solution. To ensure
her safe
escape and victory, I have to...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You want to jump down there?!
choice_data_list: フジキセキを抱いて1階へ飛び下りる

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

The zombies are nearly upon us. There's
no time
to explain. I pick her up and
hold her securely.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!
I leap! And we land on the first floor.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a dramatic escape! And your

companion is completely unharmed!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, dangerous acts are
forbidden, so
you're disqualified!

Thus, the event ends and we leave
empty-handed
due to my
overenthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me that look! Hold out your
ankle so I
can put a compress on it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you actually did that. If
you told
me what you planned to do, I
could've...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You carried me and jumped yourself
because you
didn't want me to hurt my
legs, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It all makes sense now... I was wondering
why you
were being so pushy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... You really are something
else.

Her tender expression belies her harsh
words.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the one protecting others,
not the one
being protected...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And in the rare cases when I have been
shielded, I
always felt so bad about it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But with you... I don't know what it is,
but it feels
different with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I feel nothing but joy right now. Thank
you for
protecting me. From the bottom
of my heart.
She steps closer to me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That aside, you're still injured. As
punishment, I'm
giving you a piggyback
ride all the way home!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Stop flailing about! This is what you get
for being
so reckless.

Fuji Kiseki walks into the sunset with me
on her
back. I can't see her face, but I
can feel the
happiness radiating off her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You?! As bait?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No! Absolutely not! I can't let you do
that! If
anyone's going to be bait, it'll be
m—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: 君1人なら必ず逃げ切れる！
貴方1人なら必ず逃げ切れる！

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: だから、必ず勝って帰ってきてほしい

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget your sacrifice! I'll win for
your sake!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Captured Female Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It looks like all the zombies are
going after
the last pers—what the heck!
Isn't that Fuji
Kiseki?!

text_block_list.name: Captured Female Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Oh my gosh, it really is her!
She's
running like mad!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

Fuji Kiseki lets out a final burst of speed
and
narrowly avoids the zombie hoard's
grasp! She
slips by them and wins!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I did it! Those zombies were so
fast, I nearly
got caught.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but I couldn't have done it
without the
spell you cast on me.
choice_data_list: いい走りっぷりだった！

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you remember? You said, "You
can make
it!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you remember? You said, "You
can make
it!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: After hearing those words, I knew I had to make it. You had so much faith in me, I couldn't let you down.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Your words literally have a
magical power
over me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They gave me so much more strength
than I
could've ever imagined. I'm
invincible so long as
you're with me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could run to the literal ends
of the
world with a single magical word
of
encouragement from you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Or something like that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In any case, this was such a fun event!
We should
do it again sometime.

Fuji Kiseki and I plan our next outing
together
while slowly making our way
home.
